title_top: 8 rare things. One try every single day.
title_main: IF YOU TRIED ONCE A DAY...
title_sub: how long until you'd finally win?

items.label: Double sixes
items.source: Odds: 1 in 36 (dice math). Average wait = 1 / odds tries

items.label: Yahtzee in one roll
items.source: Odds: 1 in 1,296 (6 / 6^5). Average wait = 1 / odds tries

items.label: A hole-in-one
items.source: Odds: about 1 in 12,500 for an average golfer (Hole-in-One Registry via PGA.com)

items.label: Guess a 6-digit PIN
items.context: Start in ancient Rome, finish in the 1980s
items.source: Odds: 1 in 1,000,000 (10^6 PINs); Rome's traditional founding 753 BC

items.label: A monkey types "banana"
items.context: Almost 3x longer than humans have existed

items.label: Guess a phone number
items.context: 40% of the time since the dinosaurs died
items.source: Odds: 1 in 10^10; dinosaurs went extinct about 66 million years ago

items.label: A perfect bracket
items.context: 1.8 MILLION times the age of the universe
items.source: Odds: 1 in 2^63 if every game is a coin flip; universe is 13.8 billion years old

outro_line: 1 in a million sounds impossible. Out of 8 billion people, that's 8,000 winners.

hook.top: A perfect March Madness bracket would take
hook.bottom: if you filled out one every single day.
hook.loop: But one of these takes just 5 weeks...
